honorifics.note: Use 'Allah Ta'ala' in narrative; plain 'Allah' inside quoted verses/hadith and in fixed phrases (Alhamdulillah, Insha'Allah, La ilaha illallah). 'Subhanahu wa Ta'ala' only when the source stresses it.

triggers: peace and blessings be upon him
honorifics.note: Write 'Rasoolullah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)' or 'Nabi (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)' or 'Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)'; in full, in parentheses, after every mention; never SAW/PBUH.
After the name of every prophet other than Muhammad; Maryam takes (Alaihassalam); 'Ambiya-e-Kiraam (Alaihimussalam)' for the group.
Male companion: Anhu; female: Anha; two: Anhuma; group: Anhum; group of women: Anhunna.
After the name of every deceased scholar or righteous person who is not a prophet or companion.
Only when the source indicates the scholar is living or uses this honorific.
